svg.text: Canonical EN board · presets + Custom · global/per-book scope · physical controls

g.text: Any manual change switches the preset to Custom.
Changes apply immediately and keep the semantic reading position.

svg.text: • Confirm on a preset applies that preset. Manual +/- or alignment changes set the active preset to Custom.
• Proposed test ranges: font 16–30 px (2 px), line spacing 1.10–1.60 (0.05), margins 16–56 px (4 px).
• These numerical ranges remain firmware constants pending real 3.97-inch panel readability testing.
